name: Surfer
description: Unknown creatures invade the earth, human health sends out dangerous signals, and the world is shrouded in haze. At a time when everyone is helpless, the Panda Guards step forward. Each soldier has extraordinary skills and has the courage to face dangers and difficulties, just to protect human health and regain happiness and sunshine! Each panda display has its own style, fancy masks, and artistic graffiti, which are cool and adorable.
